title: Morra
tagline: Throw your fingers. Call the total.
description: The ancient finger game of the Roman table. Both players throw out zero to five fingers at once and shout a guess of the total; the exact call scores. Read five osteria rivals with their own habits, while the strongest ones read you right back. Watch and Learn, a Hint button, a full Rules page and text size up to 300%. Points only, works offline.
howToPlay: Tap how many fingers to throw, from 0 to 5.
Tap the total you call: your throw plus the fingers you expect from the rival.
Press Throw. The fist pumps uno, due, tre and both hands open together.
Call the exact total of all the fingers and you score; both right or both wrong scores nothing.
First to the target wins the duel. Each rival has habits to read.
Use Hint to see what the table knows, or Watch and Learn to see a whole duel.
On a keyboard: keys 0 to 5 throw, Q to P call 0 to 9, Enter throws, H hints.
